items.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
items.summary: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.

items.title: Bizarre Rescue Sees Divers Save Kangaroo That Found Itself Over a Mile from Dry Land
